author: Chris Cooley
name: Dirt Hop
tagline: One bike. Every kind of dirt.
description: A dirt bike game on a tabletop: one bike and a garage, races against rivals, a free-ride park, a Big Air show and Wheelie City. Earn credits, wear out tyres and top ends, rebuild, mod and paint. Neon at night, pastel by day.
controls: W/S or ↑/↓ — lean (back lifts the front) · A/D — steer
L — trick (Big Air) or hop (Wheelie City) · P — pause · V — camera
